headline: A planetary-scale technology backbone for climate action.
sub: Four production modules unified under one platform: Web3 governance, NFT-based carbon credits, an IoT sensor mesh, and AI-driven sustainability reporting.
challenge: Erthaloka needed a single technology backbone for climate action — DAO governance, a tradable carbon market, live environmental telemetry, and audit-ready reporting — all running in production, not as a pitch deck.
solutionsIntro: We built a unified platform that puts governance, markets, sensors, and reporting under one roof:

solutions.title: DAO Governance
solutions.description: Token-weighted voting, treasury, and proposal lifecycle shipped as audited Solidity contracts.

solutions.title: NFT Carbon Market
solutions.description: Tokenized carbon credits with provenance, retirement, and on-chain settlement.

solutions.title: IoT Sensor Mesh
solutions.description: Custom firmware and an MQTT pipeline streaming environmental data from field to cloud.

solutions.title: AI Reporting
solutions.description: ML models turning raw sensor and satellite data into auditable sustainability reports.

feedback.quote: Bhanixs shipped what most teams only diagram — governance, market, sensors, and reporting, all live, all owned by us.
feedback.name: Erthaloka Core Team

headline: A coin-powered marketplace for circular services.
sub: A digital wallet system, service discovery, and user dashboard connecting a growing user base to hundreds of services from verified organisations.
challenge: The Erthaloka ecosystem needed a real marketplace where its native coin could unlock tangible services — from co-living spaces to sustainable travel — with a trust layer of verified organisations and a seamless user experience.
solutionsIntro: We built a full coin-powered marketplace with wallet, discovery, booking, and admin layers:

solutions.title: Digital Wallet
solutions.description: Secure coin wallet with top-up, balance tracking, and full transaction history.

solutions.title: Service Marketplace
solutions.description: Browse and book services across ten-plus categories from verified organisations.

solutions.title: User Dashboard
solutions.description: A personalised view of wallet, bookings, spending, and account status.

solutions.title: Admin Portal
solutions.description: A JWT-secured admin layer for managing the full platform ecosystem.

headline: A circular economy powered by on-chain infrastructure.
sub: A complete on-chain economic layer: an ERC-20 utility token, DAO governance, DeFi lending, an NFT marketplace, and a DApp — built for the Erthaloka ecosystem.
challenge: The Erthaloka circular economy needed a native token and decentralised economic infrastructure — payments, governance, and DeFi — built transparently on-chain without relying on centralised intermediaries.
solutionsIntro: We built the full on-chain economic layer for the ecosystem:

solutions.title: ERT Token
solutions.description: An ERC-20 utility and governance token with a transparent allocation model on Ethereum.

solutions.title: DAO Governance
solutions.description: A smart-contract-based proposal and voting system for token-holder governance.

solutions.title: DeFi Protocol
solutions.description: A microloan and borrowing protocol generating interest revenue on-chain.

solutions.title: DApp + NFT
solutions.description: A marketplace DApp with payments, subscriptions, and an integrated NFT engine.

headline: Spatial computing across three verticals.
sub: Three production AR/VR applications — restaurant AR menus, BIM-to-AR construction overlays, and immersive VR architecture walkthroughs — on one shared pipeline.
challenge: Arteco's clients across restaurants and construction needed spatial experiences that worked on the devices people already own — without a six-month build cycle per project.
solutionsIntro: We built three production spatial apps on a shared asset and tooling pipeline:

solutions.title: AR Menus
solutions.description: Photoreal 3D dishes anchored on the table with allergen and nutrition overlays.

solutions.title: BIM → AR
solutions.description: Converting BIM models into mobile AR overlays site teams can walk through in minutes.

solutions.title: VR Walkthroughs
solutions.description: Quest-ready immersive walkthroughs for client presentations and design review.

solutions.title: Shared Pipeline
solutions.description: One asset and build pipeline powering iOS, Android, and Quest from the same source.

headline: A four-agent system for autonomous marketing operations.
sub: Research, creative, ops, and analytics agents coordinate end-to-end across Meta and Google, with humans in the loop only for approvals.
challenge: Cravent's team was drowning in manual campaign operations — briefs, creatives, launches, and reporting across two ad platforms — leaving no time for strategy.
solutionsIntro: We built a four-agent system that owns the campaign lifecycle end-to-end:

solutions.title: Research Agent
solutions.description: Pulls audience, competitor, and trend data into structured briefs.

solutions.title: Creative Agent
solutions.description: Generates ad variants — copy, image prompts, hooks — from briefs.

solutions.title: Ops Agent
solutions.description: Pushes approved creatives live to Meta and Google with budget guardrails.

solutions.title: Analytics Agent
solutions.description: Watches performance, flags winners and losers, recommends reallocations.

solutionsIntro: We rebuilt the platform foundations end-to-end:

solutions.description: GitHub Actions with preview environments, tests, and zero-downtime deploys.

solutions.title: Observability
solutions.description: Grafana, Prometheus, and logs with paging on real user-impacting symptoms.

solutions.title: Performance Tuning
solutions.description: Image, font, and bundle work taking Core Web Vitals all green.
